title: M7-04 — session_start + session_stop + capabilities DTOs + SessionMetadata extension (foundation only)
scope_decision: FOUNDATION_ONLY — dispatcher + wrappers + shims deferred to m7-05

commits.subject: feat(services): add session_start + session_stop + capabilities DTOs (m7-04)
feat(store): add tail_sealed + sealed_at to SessionMetadata (m7-04)
docs(milestones): mark m7-04 as foundation-only cycle (m7-05 picks up dispatchers)

scope_split_rationale: session_start{action=spawn} needs ProbeService::start (async) — first async dispatcher in chronos-services
session_stop{drain_subscriptions=true} chains to observe{verb=list} which requires ObserveContext (tripwire_manager + uprobe_counter) from MCP server
session_stop{seal_tail=true} needs SessionMetadata update; store API is save_session (overwrite) — load+mutate+save round-trip
ProbeContext testability — unit tests would need leaking statics or sandbox-only fixtures
Avoided shipping speculative dispatcher with invented APIs (ObserveContext::from_probe_only, ObserveInputResolve) and unsafe zeroing of TripwireManager

dto_layer.engine_version_baked: chronos-0.1.0 (m7-02/03 precedent; QueryEngine::engine_version() does not exist yet)

metadata_extension.serde_compat: #[serde(default)] ensures v2 metadata files load correctly into v3 reader

gates.T1_workspace_lib_ex_chronos_native: pass (788/788 passed + 4 ignored; matches m7-03 baseline — no regressions from SessionMetadata extension)
gates.T2_per_crate_integration_services_store_: pass (343 integration tests across the 3 changed crates)
gates.behaviour_change: NONE — only net-new types + additive SessionMetadata field; no existing tool affected

followups.scope: dispatcher + MCP wrappers + v1 shims + T4 smoke (probe_lifecycle + session_lifecycle + program_scenarios)
depends_on: store:load_session + save_session round-trip is sufficient for seal
